Inventory & market movement

Confirmed retail sales: no independent transaction data
Daily comparison and presumed-sales estimate

New Today includes VINs present now but absent from the baseline, including returning VINs. Dropped Today includes VINs present in the baseline but absent now. These labels refer to the snapshot date, not your device's date.

Presumed Sales — Persistent DS Disappearances counts each currently absent VIN whose last observed status was Dealer Stock immediately, with no waiting period. Reappearing VINs are automatically excluded; a later DS disappearance counts once while absent. Last-observed In Transit VINs are excluded. This is an estimate, not confirmed retail sales, and creates no permanent sale classification.

VIN Production Tracking

Serial coverage is not a U.S. market share or production percentage. Missing numbers do not establish unsold vehicles, exports, actual builds, or a particular destination. The highest observed VIN serial is not necessarily the highest vehicle actually produced.

Historical VIN Tracking

MonthHighest Observed VINChange From Prior Month

Monthly figures represent the highest VIN serial observed by the tracker, not actual monthly production. VINs may appear in the tracker days or weeks after production.

Changes show serial-number progression. No new observations carry the prior maximum forward; unavailable values are shown as —.
